notes.title: Player names on cards, Skip Pass nerfed, bugfixes...
notes.content: [h1]Update 2.5.5 is live:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265589/83914db472b5eb400e7f8dc23334c4f0288ec88e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's new:[/h2][list][*][p]Added option to show player names on cards[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to show player name and position in rankings[/p][/*][*][p]Skip Pass costs 1 stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina upgrade for Deluxe Locker Room is no longer duplicated[/p][/*][*][p]When upgrading card draw, show a hint above the draw icons[/p][/*][*][p]Scale down keyword descriptions if they cannot fit the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Show the correct card cost in draw and discard piles after a card was played with modified cost[/p][/*][*][p]Auto play only stops for mapped keys, ignoring Alt+Tab and similar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed default DPI for scaled displays[/p][/*][*][p]Added display scaling option in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to use the right mouse click on End Turn button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cut-off bug with certain screen resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Added hint that you can click the team name during match to see their deck[/p][/*][*][p]Mods can now load CSV files using cbLoadCSV(2)[/p][/*][*][p]Warn about missing mods when loading a saved game[/p][/*][*][p]Modded cards in Team Editor now load properly after restart[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text layout in some languages when you have no players in top 10 during halftime card choice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The same changes are coming to Android version as well as soon as Play Store approves it.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Faster gameplay, team editor, Steam Workshop support and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265589/7c148ea85d85ef56c04ea9ba15a0142a4b141e29.png[/img]

[h1]Changes since the first demo release[/h1]

[h2]New features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Modding support (Steam Workshop integration)
[*] Team editor is integrated into the game
[*] Show unlocked cards when you beat every difficulty level
[*] Allow selecting variable number of teams in Full Season
[*] Ability to interrupt autoplay by clicking anywhere on the screen
[*] Upgrade card name uses +2,+3,+4 instead of ++,+++,+++, etc.
[*] Game animation speed increase up to 9x
[*] Separate option for auto play animation speed
[*] Option to slow down animation near game end
[*] Turn shot clock off when the game clock has less time remaining
[*] New card effect: Instant until played
[*] New card effect: Shotclock manipulation (ex. set Shot clock to 14)
[*] New mechanics: Boost (permanently upgrade card numbers during match)
[*] New mechanics: Leverage (destroy cards to permanently upgrade another card)
[*] Added TAB autocomplete for card names in console commands %get and %add
[*] Added animation icons for stamina gain
[*] Added missing bump animations for card upgrades during match
[*] Show notice when quarter is about to end in the bottom left corner
[*] Time spent per card played is configurable in Settings (default 15 seconds)
[*] Show number of card plays remaining in the period
[/list]


[h2]Mods[/h2]

Added 6 example mods to Steam Workshop:

[list]
[*] Air Ball (card)
[*] Inspiration (card)
[*] Card cost details (deck cost, this match, this turn)
[*] Flags for national teams
[*] Player name generator
[*] Ability to speed autoplay to 99x (almost instant)
[/list]


[h2]Cards[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved card graphics
[*] New card: Kick Ball (set shot clock to 14)
[*] Removed card: Delay of Game
[*] Redesigned Circus Shot (Permanent upgrade to Timeout)
[*] Redesigned Skip Pass (no cost increase, discard to top of draw pile)
[*] Redesigned Pick and Roll (does what Behind the Back Pass used to do)
[*] Redesigned Behind the Back Pass (Permanent Shot upgrade)
[*] Redesigned Eurostep (Permanent 2P Shot upgrade)
[*] Redesigned Box Out (Rebounds instant, No cost increase)
[*] Redesigned Cleanup (Pull and Destroy Hindrances)
[*] Redesigned Offensive Rebound (+Shotclock per cards in deck)
[*] Nerfed Underdog (-2 cost to all cards)
[*] Nerfed Substitution (+1 cost for match instead of turn)
[*] Buffed numbers: Buzzer Beater, Mascot, Benchwarmer, Jump Ball, Control Dribble, Goaltending
[*] Added Leverage to Ball Hog, Pick and Pop
[*] Added Draw 1 to Pass
[*] Added Boost to Shooting drill
[*] All temporary cards use the black skin now
[/list]


[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Respect card drop level and drop count limit when getting random cards
[*] Respect card drop level and drop count limit when giving upgrade events
[*] Fixed controller icons for Steam Deck (which broke after last Steam Deck update)
[*] Fixed description for Playoff mode unlock
[*] Fixed text layout bugs (esp. when card gets upgraded during game)
[*] Fixed bug where wrong value for noise was shown when multiple cards affect noise
[*] Fixed bug where finished game would continue into overtime if you press enter too fast
[*] Fixed timing of sound effect for card stacking
[*] Fixed occasional glow showing on top of selected card
[/list]
